name: brain
description: Keeps a repo's session log — the record of every commit that reached main and the story around it — through three acts: /brain:session start creates a session from a description, /brain:session log records a commit and updates what it made stale, /brain:session close finishes a session and its plan part; a tool gates every commit against the log and scaffolds the docs a repo needs. The one plugin that will carry the whole toolset (ADR-002).
